issues.issue: Was the mandamus application to compel a decision still live?
issues.applicant_position: Mandamus sought to compel the H&C ruling; counsel conceded it is moot once decided.
issues.result_quote: Since the H&C decision has now been rendered, the application for mandamus is now moot.

issues.issue: Should the unsworn human rights lawyer report from India be admitted on judicial review?
issues.applicant_position: Report may be filed under s. 24 Charter and international norms despite late filing and no affidavit.
issues.respondent_position: Opposed filing; reviewing court must consider only the record before the original decision-maker.
issues.result_quote: I dismissed the motion, essentially for the reasons put forward by the respondent.

issues.issue: Did the officer err in assessing the risk to the applicant (wrong test, corroborating evidence, country conditions)?
issues.applicant_position: Officer applied PRRA-style risk test, ignored corroborating evidence and misread current country conditions for Sikhs.
issues.result_quote: As a result, I have not been persuaded that this is a case where the intervention of this Court would be warranted.

issues.issue: Did the officer err in weighing time in Canada and the applicant's establishment?
issues.applicant_position: Officer erred in assessing length of time in Canada and degree of establishment.
issues.result_quote: this is not sufficient to overturn the decision of the H&C officer.

issues.issue: Did the officer fail to explain or consider the best interests of the child?
issues.applicant_position: Officer failed to explain why best interests of the child were not given weight.
issues.result_quote: it cannot be said that the officer was blind to the best interests of the applicant’s child.

issues.issue: Should questions be certified for appeal?
issues.applicant_position: Proposed two general questions for certification.
issues.respondent_position: Proposed questions are too vague and based on unproven assumptions; not determinative.
issues.result_quote: There shall accordingly be no certified questions.
